S4 method focus.query: (SMOTE OR oversampling OR "over-sampling" OR "synthetic minority") AND (imbalanced OR imbalance OR "minority class") AND (propose OR proposed OR novel OR "new method" OR algorithm)

S5 final (S1 or S2, wider).query: (SMOTE OR oversampling OR "over-sampling" OR "synthetic minority" OR "adaptive synthetic" OR "synthetic samples" OR "synthetic instances") AND (imbalanced OR imbalance OR "minority class" OR "minority classes")
